text: Spin-off into an existing .bowman (integrate spun-off aims as free-floating)
description: Deferred remainder of the basic spin-off. When the chosen target path already contains a .bowman, the basic version only warns and stops. Extend it to allow proceeding: merge the spun-off aims into the existing target graph as free-floating aims (no parents) so the user can reparent them into the target's structure. Handle ID collisions. Postponed until basic spin-off lands.
reflection: Implemented conservative existing-graph spin-off integration. Existing target metadata and phases remain authoritative; copied branch structure is preserved with free-floating roots; colliding aim IDs are remapped consistently across internal edges; archived-only/initialized targets are recognized; self-targeting is rejected. Added pure remapping and filesystem integration tests. Verification: shared tests 24/24, backend tests 61/61, backend build and complete frontend build/type-check passed, git diff --check passed.

status.comment: Implemented integration into an existing .bowman; awaiting user acceptance after UI/runtime review.
